title: Sub-Gaussian tails for Rademacher and Gaussian sums
statement: Let $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $\sum_i a_i^2=1$, and suppose $|a_i|\leq\varepsilon$ for every $i$. For every $t\geq0$, if $X$ is uniform on $\{-1,1\}^n$ and $Z$ is standard Gaussian, then both $\mathbb{P}(|\sum_i a_iX_i|\geq t)$ and $\mathbb{P}(|Z|\geq t)$ are at most $2e^{-t^2/2}$.
